metadata.title: Preparing and submitting summary reports for marketed drugs and natural health products (guidance) and notice of update
metadata.edition: Health Canada guidance (issued 2025-10-24) and notice of 2026-09-04 · Revised guidance effective 2026-10-01
metadata.legal_basis: Agency guidance or notice under the Food and Drug Regulations; legislation prevails.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: The updates clarify long-standing requirements to prepare annual summary reports and make clear that annual summary reports should only be provided to the Minister upon receipt of a written request from Health Canada.
candidates.context: Revised guidance on preparing and submitting summary reports for marketed drugs and natural health products The updates also describe how to notify the Minister of significant changes to what is known about the product's risks and benefits, using a new form. These updates also explain that you should notify Health Canada of a significant change only if it meets the threshold outlined in guidance, per the definition.

candidates.context: The updates clarify long-standing requirements to prepare annual summary reports and make clear that annual summary reports should only be provided to the Minister upon receipt of a written request from Health Canada. As part of Health Canada's red tape reduction efforts, these changes are intended to reduce burden by minimizing duplicate reporting and over-reporting.
